name: Orim
description: Weatherlight crewmember who later killed the Chief Magistrate with a Kyren poison dart.

description_citations.text: "Tower of the Magistrate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna befriends Orim at university and the two join the crew of the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Hanna befriended Orim while at the university, and later the pair joined the crew of Weatherlight .

citation.text: "Hanna", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mirri dives in front of Crovax to deflect Selenia's strike and is gravely wounded; Crovax slays Selenia and Tahngarth carries both back to the ship.
timeline.quote: Mirri dove in front of him to deflect one of Selenia's strikes.

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orim tells Gerrard he must work hard yet appear effortless like the drake.
timeline.quote: You *must* do the same.

citation.text: Wind Drake (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard asks Orim whether it is too late for prayer as sludge shifts in the Death Pits.
timeline.quote: it's a little too late for prayer, isn't it?

citation.text: Death Pits of Rath (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Orim places a lightning rod on the bow and the Furnace turns on her.
timeline.quote: That's when the Furnace got personal.

citation.text: Havoc (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: On Rath, Crovax sees Selenia leading an attack against the Weatherlight and breaks down.
timeline.quote: Embittered by his love's betrayal, Crovax became obsessed with getting revenge.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Descent into madness". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orim writes that never has she seen so many made sick, and that they will never eat Squee's cooking again.
timeline.quote: We will *never* eat Squee's cooking again.

citation.text: Medicine Bag (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth admits that the Weatherlight needs Gerrard.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth begrudgingly admits to Orim that the Weatherlight needs Gerrard

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Tahngarth's Tale" ( Hannovi Braddock )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax is transformed by his angel's death.
timeline.quote: having been transformed by his guardian angel's death

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Crovax's Tale" ( Kij Johnson )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orim says prayer rarely explains.
timeline.quote: Prayer rarely explains.

citation.text: Soltari Monk (World Championship Decks 1998, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After Gerrard, Tahngarth and Karn are arrested in Mercadia, Sisay, Hanna and Orim strike a deal with the Chief Magistrate to travel to Saprazzo for the Power Matrix.
timeline.quote: After the arrest of Gerrard , Tahngarth , and Karn in Mercadia

citation.text: "The Legacy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orim wakes with no memory and a dead guard's blood on her hands.
timeline.quote: the first thing she could remember was waking up with the dead guard's blood on her hands.

citation.text: Arrest (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Cho-Manno tells Orim he did not choose his role and neither did Gerrard.
timeline.quote: I did not choose my role, Orim," said Cho-Manno patiently

citation.text: Ivory Mask (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Orim condemns Gerrard and he offers no defense.
timeline.quote: Gerrard offered no defense to Orim's condemnation

citation.text: Renounce (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Orim teaches Ta-Karnst and the Cho-Arrim healers a less invasive healing method.
timeline.quote: Orim taught Ta-Karnst and the other Cho-Arrim healers a far less invasive method of healing.

citation.text: Soothing Balm (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The crew escapes Mercadia City with the Cho-Arrim prisoners and learns of the myths of Ramos.
timeline.quote: Here, they learned of the myths of Ramos and why the Cho-Arrim had taken the Weatherlight to begin with

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Power Matrix is stolen and the women are framed; Cho-Manno finds the real thief too late.
timeline.quote: the Power Matrix was stolen shortly after their arrival, and the women were framed for the crime.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orim learns that Cho-Manno took the Weatherlight's arrival as a sign of Ramos's return, and grows sympathetic to the Cho-Arrim.
timeline.quote: Orim slowly becomes sympathetic to the Cho-Arrim's situation and is attracted to their leader.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Takara brokers a new deal: the crew will repair the Weatherlight for the magistrate in exchange for freedom; Sisay, Hanna and Orim head to Saprazzo for a needed artifact.
timeline.quote: Takara brokers a new deal with the magistrate

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klaars attacks Is-Shada and kills the guard while escaping the Cho-Arrim cell.
timeline.quote: When Is-Shada brings them a meal, Klaars pounces on her, rendering her unconscious, and then attacks and kills the guard.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klaars is executed by Ta-Spon.
timeline.quote: At the leader’s nod, Klaars is dispatched.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Cho-Arrim treat the Weatherlight as the sign of the return of Ramos.
timeline.quote: The Weatherlight is treated as the sign of the return of Ramos, their god.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Cho-Arrim repel a cateran attack on the Rushwood, which had come to seize the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: The tide turns and the Cho-Arrim skyscouts fly down to surround the caterans.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orim and Cho-Manno kiss.
timeline.quote: Cho Manno agrees and they kiss.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The caterans massacre the Cho-Arrim settlement.
timeline.quote: As the cateran mercenaries emerge out of the forest into the Cho-Arrim settlement they start massacring everyone.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orim rejects Gerrard's apology at his staged trial.
timeline.quote: Orim simply threw her turban at his feet.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The magistrate lets the crew keep the Weatherlight in exchange for a mission to Saprazzo for the Matrix.
timeline.quote: The magistrate agrees to allow them to repair and keep the Weatherlight, in exchange for using it on a mission of the magistrate's choice.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Saprazzan warrior beast drags Orim under the sea.
timeline.quote: the warrior beast grabs Orim and drags her under the sea.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orim arrives riding the whale-like creature and heals the dying Sisay.
timeline.quote: She calls on both sides to put away their arms, and then she heals Sisay.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orim is framed for murder and theft by the Saprazzan conspirator Oustrathmer.
timeline.quote: She awakes to find the Saprazzan conspirator as the commander of her guard, a man named Oustrathmer.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cho-Manno, believed dead, appears and clears Orim's name through a mind meld.
timeline.quote: Orim submits to a mind meld with Cho-Manno, who then declares her innocence.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Disguised as guards, the crew and Cho-Manno free Gerrard using a storm.
timeline.quote: The new guards are the rest of the Weatherlight crew, plus Cho-Manno.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Ramosans rebel against the Kyren and kill the Chief Magistrate and his advisors.
timeline.quote: They make their way towards the Magistrate’s Tower and attack and kill the Chief Magistrate and his Kyren advisors.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orim, Cho-Manno and Atalla become the new leaders of Mercadia as the crew planeshifts back to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: They return with Orim, Cho-Manno, and Atalla, new leaders of Mercadia.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands on Mercadia; the Cho-Arrim seize the ship and Orim, and Mercadians capture the rest of the crew.
timeline.quote: The Cho-Arrim , a reclusive forest-dwelling people, seized the ship along with Orim

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard negotiates with the Chief Magistrate to train the city's forces in exchange for help reclaiming the Weatherlight; Orim allies with Cho-Manno; the Caterans slaughter the Cho-Arrim.
timeline.quote: Gerrard agreed to train the city’s forces

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With hostages held, the Mercadians force Hanna, Sisay and Orim to retrieve the Power Matrix from Saprazzo, then steal it and murder its guardians.
timeline.quote: the Mercadians betrayed them again, stealing the artifact and murdering its guardians while attempting to frame Orim

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Under Volrath's control, Hanna, Karn and Squee are forced to repair the Weatherlight; the revolutionary forces attack.
timeline.quote: forced to repair the Weatherlight under the threat of Squee’s execution

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The crew finds Orim alive among the Cho-Arrim and learns of the myths of Ramos.
timeline.quote: they found Orim alive and flourishing

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dralnu infects Agnate with plague; Agnate asks Grizzlegom to kill him and take command; Grizzlegom destroys Dralnu's minions.
timeline.quote: Agnate asked Grizzlegom to kill him and take command of his armies

citation.text: "Agnate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna contracts a Phyrexian plague at the start of the Invasion and dies hours before Orim's cure is ready.
timeline.quote: Soon, Orim devised a cure, but it came hours too late to save her.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians kill everyone in Benalia City and decimate Urza's armies; Hanna is wounded and contracts Phyrexian Plague.
timeline.quote: Orim diagnoses Hanna with Phyrexian Plague.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The crew captures Phyrexians on Rath and Orim devises a serum that stops the plague, but it is too late for Hanna.
timeline.quote: The crew is made immune, but it's too late to do anything for Hanna.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A year after the Invasion, Karn takes Orim back to Mercadia, and Sisay, Tahngarth and Squee receive a new vessel named Victory.
timeline.quote: which she named Victory

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A year later Freyalise erects a monument, and Karn, as an accumulation of the Legacy, takes Orim to Mercadia while Sisay, Squee and Tahngarth sail on the Victory.
timeline.quote: One year later, in a ceremony attended by survivors from all over the globe

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay, Orim and Hanna arrive in Saprazzo seeking the Power Matrix; Sisay is wounded after a sailor harpoons a Breaker and Orim heals her.
timeline.quote: only to be saved by Orim, who called for peace and used her healing abilities to restore her captain.

citation.text: "Saprazzo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orim discovers a plot to steal the Matrix and frame the crew, and is imprisoned, falsely accused.
timeline.quote: Orim was ambushed and imprisoned, falsely accused of murder and theft.

citation.text: "Saprazzo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cho-Manno appears with Lahaime and proves Orim's innocence by mind meld.
timeline.quote: Cho-Manno proved Orim’s innocence

citation.text: "Saprazzo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lahaime stages his own execution to feed the Mercadians false intelligence; the crew gets safe passage back to Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Lahaime staged his own "execution" before Oustrathmer

citation.text: "Saprazzo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orim warns that if the enemy boards them they are finished; Crovax nods.
timeline.quote: "If they board us we're finished," warned Orim.

citation.text: Respite (Conspiracy, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Orim tells Gerrard he is like the drake and must seem to glide effortlessly.
timeline.quote: Orim regarded Gerrard coolly.

citation.text: Wind Drake (Tempest Remastered, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard asks Orim whether it is too late for prayer as sludge shifts in the Death Pits of Rath.
timeline.quote: I suppose," he said, "it's a little too late for prayer, isn't it?

citation.text: Death Pits of Rath (Tempest Remastered, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After the Phyrexian invasion, Orim joins the Cho-Arrim through her marriage with Cho-Manno.
timeline.quote: they were joined by the healer Orim through her marriage with Cho-Manno

citation.text: "Cho-Arrim", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4205 AR the Cho-Arrim bring Orim aboard the Weatherlight to Rushwood alongside the wounded Drianan and Klaars, who both die.
timeline.quote: Orim was brought to the Rushwood aboard the Skyship Weatherlight by the Cho-Arrim

citation.text: "Rushwood", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard, Orim and the Weatherlight crew are arrested and brought to Mercadia City.
timeline.quote: brought to Mercadia City

citation.text: "Rushwood", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay, Hanna, Orim and Takara-Volrath strike a deal for a stay of execution for Gerrard, Tahngarth and Karn in exchange for obtaining the Power Matrix from Saprazzo.
timeline.quote: They obtained a stay of execution and relocation to better quarters for the three prisoners

citation.text: "Tower of the Magistrate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Revolution, Cho-Manno, Orim and others attack the tower and Orim kills the Chief Magistrate with a Kyren poison dart.
timeline.quote: Orim killed him using a Kyren poison dart

citation.text: "Tower of the Magistrate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Cho-Arrim", section "Notable Cho-Arrim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
